customInstructions: Read AGENTS.md first for the full universal AI-agent guide.
Video2Text is an offline video transcription tool (Python 3.8+).
All user-visible strings must go through t() from douyin_batch/i18n.py.
Add new i18n keys to the Messages class as {"en": "...", "zh": "..."}.
Use pathlib.Path everywhere. No hard-coded / or \ separators.
PEP 604 / PEP 585 syntax requires `from __future__ import annotations`.
Run `python run_tests.py` after any change. 38 tests must pass.
Never add deps without updating pyproject.toml and requirements.txt.
